name: FrontendBuild
defaultParams: TARGET_CITY="Almeria" BASE_URL="https://orbitatest.b-cdn.net/" OUT_DIR="dist" NO_DOWNLOAD_IMAGES="1" BUNNY_STORAGE_ZONE="orbitastorage" BUNNY_STORAGE_API_KEY=""

steps.name: snapshot_master_events
commit_and_push_snapshot
build_frontend
upload_to_bunny
steps.script:
echo "[upload_to_bunny] Ejecutando docker run..."; echo "docker run --rm --entrypoint sh -e BUNNY_STORAGE_ZONE=\"$BUNNY_STORAGE_ZONE\" -e BUNNY_STORAGE_API_KEY=\"$BUNNY_STORAGE_API_KEY\" -e CITY_SLUG=\"$CITY_SLUG\" -v /home/ubuntu/work/frontend_build/test_frontend/dist:/app/dist infra_scripts-test_frontend:latest -c 'set -eu; cd /app/dist/$CITY_SLUG; lftp -u \"$BUNNY_STORAGE_ZONE,$BUNNY_STORAGE_API_KEY\" storage.bunnycdn.com -e \"cd $CITY_SLUG; mirror -R --delete --parallel=25 . .; bye\"'"; docker run --rm --entrypoint sh \
  -e BUNNY_STORAGE_ZONE="$BUNNY_STORAGE_ZONE" \
  -e BUNNY_STORAGE_API_KEY="$BUNNY_STORAGE_API_KEY" \
  -e CITY_SLUG="$CITY_SLUG" \
  -v /home/ubuntu/work/frontend_build/test_frontend/dist:/app/dist \
  infra_scripts-test_frontend:latest \
  -c "set -eu; cd /app/dist/$CITY_SLUG; lftp -u \"$BUNNY_STORAGE_ZONE,$BUNNY_STORAGE_API_KEY\" storage.bunnycdn.com -e \"cd $CITY_SLUG; mirror -R --delete --parallel=25 . .; bye\""
